videos.caption: A worker in Nepal filmed the moment he escaped deadly flash floods that have left hundreds of people dead.

Today, even the statue of Gautam Buddha was swept away by the devastating floods. A symbol of peace, compassion, and hope carried away by the force of nature. 💔🌊 This is not just a statue being washed away. It feels like a reminder of how powerless we can be when nature turns against us. Homes, roads, dreams, and now even symbols that have stood for peace for generations are being taken by the floodwaters, Nepal is hurting today. Behind every flood video is a family praying for safety, someone searching for their loved ones, and countless people watching everything they built disappear before their eyes. May everyone affected by this devastating flood be safe 🙏🇳🇵 May peace return to every place touched by these waters. 🕊️#NepalFlood #FloodInNepal #GautamBuddha #Buddha #Nepal

🚨 A 6-year-old girl was rescued alive after spending approximately 55 to 60 hours trapped beneath flood debris in Timure, Rasuwa District, Nepal. Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. Information about her parents remained unclear following the rescue, which has become a powerful moment of hope amid the devastating floods that have claimed numerous lives across Nepal. #Nepal #Rasuwa #Rescue #Floods #SurvivalStory

🇳🇵 WELCOME TO DASHAIN! Nepal’s biggest and most important Hindu festival, celebrated over 15 days! And ICONICALLY, it celebrates the victory of a powerful goddess over evil. 💅 According to Hindu mythology, Durga, the goddess of strength, courage and protection, battled the evil buffalo demon Mahishasura for nine days before defeating him on the tenth. A whole festival celebrating female power? I’M OBSESSED. 📍 Kathmandu Durbar Square — the historic heart of Kathmandu, home to centuries-old temples and palaces, many of which were badly damaged in the devastating 2015 earthquake and have since been restored. 👑 The Living Goddess (Kumari): Nepal has a tradition of worshipping a real-life young girl as the living embodiment of the goddess Taleju. The current Royal Kumari is just THREE YEARS OLD! She’s selected from a Buddhist family and revered by both Hindus and Buddhists. ❤️ Tika: During Dashain, families come together as elders place a red mixture of rice, yoghurt and vermilion on their loved ones’ foreheads, offering blessings for health, happiness and prosperity. And this is only the beginning of my Nepal adventure… In just a few days, this 34-year-old hag will be attempting to summit Mera Peak at 6,476 metres (21,247 ft) in the Himalayas! 🏔️ No gear, no idea, but plenty of ambition. Follow along to see if I make it to the top! VAMOS! 🇳🇵#solotravel #digitalnomadlife #fulltimetravel #lifeinyour30s

Kathmandu is the capital and largest city of Nepal, Kathmandu is the main governmental, financial, industrial, and cultural centre of Nepal. The cultural heritage of the Kathmandu Valley is illustrated by seven groups of monuments and buildings which display the full range of historic and artistic achievements for which the Kathmandu Valley is world famous. The seven include the Durbar Squares of Hanuman Dhoka (Kathmandu), Patan and Bhaktapur, the Buddhist stupas of Swayambhu and Bauddhanath and the Hindu temples of Pashupati and Changu Narayan. #Kathmandu #Nepal  #Global #Travel #foryou
